WITH total_items AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM Order_Items
),
product_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.production_type_code,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as order_item_count,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM total_items) as share_of_items
  FROM Products p
  INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.production_type_code
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.production_type_code,
    AVG(ps.avg_quantity) as avg_avg_quantity,
    AVG(ps.order_item_count) as avg_order_item_count,
    AVG(ps.share_of_items) as avg_share_of_items
  FROM product_stats ps
  GROUP BY ps.production_type_code
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ta.avg_avg_quantity) as final_avg_quantity,
  AVG(ta.avg_order_item_count) as final_avg_order_item_count,
  AVG(ta.avg_share_of_items) as final_avg_share
FROM type_averages ta
